purpose: Final frozen-run diagnostics, never a tuning criterion

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap; same sample indices for model/baseline and every species
bootstrap.interpretation: conditional uncertainty for the frozen model on iid sampled synthetic states; excludes retraining and hyperparameter-selection uncertainty

r2_definition: all sample and velocity coordinates flattened against one grand mean
moment_cautions: Signed VDF preserved; no clipping or normalization
Nonpositive mass yields null velocity/temperature; negative temperatures counted explicitly
Positive mass and temperature alone do not establish physicality
Moment comparisons exclude invalid or negative temperatures and report exclusion counts
Target-Fourier versus original manifest temperature measures label truncation/discretization; model versus Fourier target isolates prediction error
postprocessing: No postprocessing performed; any clipping/normalization recommendation must be selected on validation only
